headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginEquiv_restrict_entry
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ)
  (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (i : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PositiveRows r)
  (j : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PositiveColumns c), ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginEquiv r c) X) i j = ↑X ↑i ↑j

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginEquiv_extend_entry
headlines.statement:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ)
  (X : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.PositiveTable r c) (i : I) (j : J),
  ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.zeroMarginEquiv r c).symm X) i j =
    if hi : 0 < r i then if hj : 0 < c j then ↑X ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0 else 0
